feed.title: Joshternet What's New
feed.subtitle: A selection of recent writing and creative work from independent websites participating in the Joshternet. Entries link to the original publishers.

entry.title: Worth Wandering: The HTML Review
entry.summary: An independent literary journal where poems become rivers, stories unfold through puzzles, memories take the shape of old computers, and a collection of mouse cursors can gather in a park. Five issues of writing, art and experimentation that remind us a webpage can be much more than a place to display words.

entry.title: South current so strong I couldn’t stay in one spot. I don’t think of it as fighting the ocean as much as I think of it as dancing with it. Hurts when its feet step on my toes. I don’t think I can really hurt the ocean’s toes. Metaphorically.

entry.title: Veteran's Day 46 Mile Ride
entry.summary: It’s been a few weeks since I did a “longer” ride - something over 30 miles - and I’ve been itching to do it. I was sick a couple of weeks ago and have had family commitments the past few weeks, along with some bad weather conditions. Since I had Veteran’s Day off, I took advantage of it and the beautiful weather to do a long ride.
